description: Free, open-source screen sharing for private live streams with friends. Watch together in a browser or self-host Piik. 免费开源的私密屏幕共享，支持游戏直播、一起看电影与自部署。

latest_release.name: Piik v2.8.0
latest_release.body:
**Turn your phone into a twin-stick controller**

By default, the left stick sends WASD and the right stick moves the mouse. If the host supports a virtual gamepad, you can switch to dual analog sticks.

**手机也能当双摇杆手柄了**

默认左摇杆对应 WASD，右摇杆移动鼠标。主机支持虚拟手柄时，可以切换为双模拟摇杆。

### English

Piik 2.8.0 adds configurable touch joysticks for remote control, clearer sound settings when sharing, and help you can open from a failed share or playback screen.

- **Control from a phone or tablet.** In keyboard and mouse mode, the left stick sends WASD and the right stick moves the mouse. When the Host supports a virtual gamepad, switch to dual analog sticks. Use the main switch to turn both sticks on or off, and expand or reposition each side independently. Piik releases held input if the control session is interrupted.
- **Share the sound you want.** The source confirmation explains which sound is available and where to enable it. Browser tab audio and supported App system audio are easier to find, with guidance for keeping room voices out of the share. On Windows, capture keeps usable system audio samples even when their timestamps are uncertain.
- **Recover a missing picture or sound.** Ended viewer video enters the existing recovery flow. Browser video forwarded through the Server uses the layers the browser actually sends. The searchable bilingual Help Center walks through joining, sharing, restoring playback, and collecting diagnostics. [English Help Center](https://piik.tv/docs/)
- **Share windows on Linux.** If the desktop portal offers only windows, the App can still share a window and hides remote control when the portal cannot support it. On KDE Plasma Wayland, enabling remote control now retries with a temporary session when the desktop rejects permission persistence.
- **Use a fixed HTTPS address for invitations.** App operators with an existing public HTTPS endpoint, such as one provided through frp, can configure App to generate invitations with that address. [Fixed invitations with frp](https://piik.tv/docs/frp.html)

Update the App or self-hosted Server with the matching package outside an active share. Reopen the room page after the update.

### 中文

Piik 2.8.0 为远程控制新增可调整的触屏摇杆，分享前更容易确认声音来源，共享或播放失败时也能直接打开对应的帮助。

- **用手机或平板远程控制。** 在键鼠模式下，左摇杆对应 WASD，右摇杆控制鼠标。主机支持虚拟手柄时，可切换到双模拟摇杆。总开关可开启或关闭两个摇杆，每侧可独立展开、调整位置。控制会话中断时，Piik 会释放仍按住的输入。
- **分享想让朋友听到的声音。** 确认分享来源时，可以看到有哪些声音可用、在哪里开启。浏览器标签页音频和 App 支持的系统声音更容易找到，帮助还说明了如何避免把房间语音收进共享声音。Windows 系统音频采集会保留时间戳不确定但仍可用的音频采样。
- **画面或声音消失时恢复播放。** 观看端的视频轨道结束后会进入现有恢复流程。经服务器转发的浏览器视频会使用浏览器实际发送的分层。可搜索的双语帮助中心介绍了如何加入房间、分享、恢复播放和收集诊断信息。[中文帮助中心](https://piik.tv/docs/zh/)
- **在 Linux 上分享窗口。** 桌面门户只提供窗口时，App 仍可采集窗口，并隐藏门户无法支持的远程控制入口。 在 KDE Plasma Wayland 中开启远程控制时，如果桌面环境拒绝记住授权，Piik 会改用临时会话重试。
- **用固定 HTTPS 地址生成邀请。** 已经有公网 HTTPS 入口的 App 部署者（例如通过 frp 配置的入口）可以让 App 用该地址生成邀请链接。[使用 frp 配置固定邀请](https://piik.tv/docs/zh/frp.html)

请在共享结束后使用对应的软件包更新 App 或自托管服务器，更新完成后重新打开房间页面。

---

detail.readme:
Piik

Share the good stuff.
Private screen sharing for you and up to 20 friends.

Website · Download · AtomGit mirror · Use online · Documentation

English · 简体中文

Piik is a free, open-source screen sharing tool for private live streams with friends: games, movie nights, drawings and photos. Choose what to share and send an invitation. Your friends watch in their browsers. You can also self-host Piik on your own server.
A little room · Show / hide animation

[Features](#features) · [Get started](#get-started) · [Self-hosting](#self-hosting) · [Contributing](#contributing) ## Features - **Watch without installing.** Friends join by invitation in a desktop or mobile browser. - **Share from Piik App or an existing Piik site.** Choose a screen, window, browser tab or camera; available sources and audio depend on the platform. - **Direct connections first.** Media travels between participants where possible (P2P). A self-hosted server can provide automatic media forwarding (SFU) as a fallback. - **Rooms you control.** Invitations, room codes and optional room passwords, for one host and up to 20 viewers. - **Talk and chat together.** Join room voice, send messages and reactions, or enable on-screen chat. - **Hand control to friends.** Share an App window or screen and approve remote control. Allow friends to play together with shared keyboard/mouse or supported gamepads; take control back at any time. [Setup guide](./docs/guide/remote-control.md). - **Flexible viewing.** Light and dark themes, playback controls, picture-in-picture and a connection topology view. - **One program to host a site.** Web UI, room management and optional media forwarding are packaged together.


Interface preview · Sample room with a generated game scene

## Get started **Got an invitation?** Open the full link in a browser on your computer or phone. If the picture does not start automatically, select **Play**. 1. **Choose how to share.** On a computer, open [Piik online](https://demo.piik.tv) to share a screen, window or browser tab. A phone browser with camera access can share its camera. To share with Piik App, [download the App](https://piik.tv/#download), then extract and open it on desktop or install and open it on Android. To invite friends on another network, choose **Public invite**, then **Open Piik**. 2. Select **Start sharing** and choose what your friend will see. If you want to share sound, enable audio when the source picker offers it. 3. Once you see the preview, select **Copy** under **Admission** and send the full link to your friend. Keep the sharing tab open. If you use the App, keep it running too.

Open **Interact → Voice** to talk together, with or without picture sharing. The Host opens voice; everyone joins to listen and chooses when to turn on their microphone. Piik follows your system language: Chinese or English, with English as the fallback. Use **中 / EN / ✦** in the header to switch language or try the visual mode. The App can create a local room or temporary public invitation, and stays available to supply capture for an approved site. Keep it running while sharing. [**Illustrated getting started →**](./docs/guide/getting-started.md) · [**Troubleshooting →**](./docs/guide/troubleshooting.md) Choose a download beginning with **`piik-app`**. The guide covers installation, source selection and invitations. Browser capture requires HTTPS or `localhost`. The App's temporary public link and the online version use P2P and need a usable UDP connection between participants. For campus networks, failed media connections or virtual LANs, see [network checks and connection options](./docs/guide/network.md). ## Self-hosting Deploy Piik Server to run a site for your group.

Piik Server runs on Windows x64 and Linux x64/ARM64, with the web interface built in. Download the Server package for Linux x64 (`piik--runtime.tar.gz`) or ARM64 (`piik--linux-arm64-runtime.tar.gz`), extract it, and run: ```sh ./piik-server ``` Windows x64 uses `piik--windows-amd64-runtime.zip`; extract it and run `./piik-server.exe` in PowerShell. The same configuration applies. Open `http://localhost:8787` to try it locally. For a public site, configure your domain, HTTPS reverse proxy and STUN address. Room data is stored in SQLite. For containers, use the [Docker Compose setup](./docs/operations/self-hosting.md#docker-compose). [**Deploy your own site →**](./docs/operations/self-hosting.md) · [Configuration](./docs/standards/configuration.md) · [Run from source](./docs/README.md#run-from-source) ## Contributing Bug reports, translations, documentation improvements and pull requests are welcome. See [ways to contribute](./CONTRIBUTING.md#ways-to-help) or [help translate Piik](./docs/guide/translating.md). Use the [repository layout](./docs/standards/engineering.md#repository-layout) to find your way around. ## License Piik-owned code is [MIT licensed](./LICENSE). Dependencies retain their own [licenses and notices](./licenses/README.md). ## Project activity
detail.readme_zh:
Piik

来，看点
好康的。
私密屏幕共享，邀请最多 20 位朋友观看。

官网 · 下载 · AtomGit 镜像 · 在线版 · 文档中心

English · 简体中文

Piik 是一个免费开源的私密屏幕共享工具，适合游戏直播、一起看电影、展示绘画或分享照片。 选择画面，把邀请链接发给朋友，对方用浏览器即可观看。也支持自部署，搭建自己的 Piik 站点。
客厅小剧场 · 展开 / 收起动画

[功能](#功能) · [开始使用](#开始使用) · [自行部署](#自行部署) · [参与贡献](#参与贡献) ## 功能 - **观看无须安装。** 朋友通过邀请链接，用电脑或手机浏览器加入。 - **用 Piik App 或已有 Piik 站点分享。** 支持屏幕、窗口、浏览器标签页和摄像头；可选来源与音频能力取决于平台。 - **优先直接连接。** 画面优先在设备之间传输（P2P），自建站点可启用媒体转发（SFU）自动兜底。 - **房间由你管理。** 支持邀请链接、房间号和可选的房间密码，一位房主、最多 20 位观众。 - **边看边聊。** 加入房间语音，发送文字和表情，也可开启弹幕。 - **让朋友接手操作。** 通过 Piik App 分享窗口或屏幕并授权远控，也可允许多人共用键鼠或使用受支持的手柄一起玩，随时结束控制。[查看设置方法](./docs/guide/remote-control.zh-CN.md)。 - **灵活的观看方式。** 支持深浅主题、播放控制、画中画和连接拓扑查看。 - **一个程序就能建站。** 网页、房间管理和可选的媒体转发打包在同一服务端程序中。


界面预览 · 示例房间与生成的游戏画面

## 开始使用 **收到邀请？** 在电脑或手机浏览器打开朋友发来的完整链接即可观看。画面没有自动播放时，点 **播放**。 1. **选择分享方式。** 在电脑上分享屏幕、窗口或浏览器标签页，可以直接打开[在线版](https://demo.piik.tv)。手机浏览器支持摄像头时，也能分享摄像头画面。要用 Piik App 分享，请[下载 App](https://piik.tv/?lang=zh-CN#download)，电脑上解压后打开，安卓设备上安装后打开。邀请异地朋友时，选 **公网邀请**，再点 **进入 Piik**。 2. 点 **开始分享**，选要给朋友看的画面。如果选源窗口提供声音选项，需要分享声音时将它打开。 3. 看到预览后，在 **准入方式** 下点 **复制**，把完整链接发给朋友。分享期间保持这个标签页打开；使用 App 时也要保持 App 运行。

打开 **互动 → 语音** 即可一起聊天，开播前后都能使用。 房主开启语音后，大家自行加入收听，想说话时再打开自己的麦克风。 Piik 默认跟随系统语言，中文系统显示简体中文，其他语言显示英文。 顶部的 **中 / EN / ✦** 可切换中英文或体验纯视觉模式。 Piik App 可创建本地房间或临时公网邀请，也能在后台为已授权站点提供采集能力。分享期间需保持 App 运行。 [**图文上手教程 →**](./docs/guide/getting-started.zh-CN.md) · [**问题排查 →**](./docs/guide/troubleshooting.zh-CN.md) 选择以 **`piik-app`** 开头的程序包；教程介绍安装、选择画面和邀请朋友的完整步骤。 浏览器采集需要 HTTPS 或 `localhost`。Piik App 的公网邀请和在线版使用 P2P， 参与者之间需要可用的 UDP 通路。校园网、画面连接失败或虚拟局域网的用法，见[网络排查与连接方案](./docs/guide/network.zh-CN.md)。 ## 自行部署 部署 Piik Server，为朋友搭建自己的站点。

Piik Server 是内置网页界面的独立程序，支持 Windows x64 和 Linux x64／ARM64。 根据服务器架构下载 Linux x64 的 `piik--runtime.tar.gz` 或 ARM64 的 `piik--linux-arm64-runtime.tar.gz`，解压后运行： ```sh ./piik-server ``` Windows x64 可下载 `piik--windows-amd64-runtime.zip`，解压后在 PowerShell 运行 `./piik-server.exe`；配置方式相同。 打开 `http://localhost:8787` 即可在本机试用。对外提供服务时， 再配置域名、HTTPS 反向代理和 STUN 地址。房间数据保存在 SQLite 中。 也可以使用 [Docker Compose 部署](./docs/operations/self-hosting.zh-CN.md#使用-docker-compose)。 [**部署自己的站点 →**](./docs/operations/self-hosting.zh-CN.md) · [配置参考](./docs/standards/configuration.md) · [从源码运行](./docs/README.md#run-from-source) ## 参与贡献 欢迎反馈问题、参与翻译、改进文档或贡献代码。 从[社区参与方式](./CONTRIBUTING.md#ways-to-help)或 [翻译教程](./docs/guide/translating.zh-CN.md)开始，也可以从 [项目目录说明](./docs/standards/engineering.md#repository-layout)了解代码结构。 ## 许可 Piik 自有代码采用 [MIT 许可](./LICENSE)，依赖保留各自的[许可与声明](./licenses/README.md)。 ## 项目动态
